2.original: I... I doubt Kami's going to do anything bad to him, at least.

3.original: Well, either way, we better find the other six Dragon Balls and resurrect him, fast.

4.original:
?!

Hey, speaking of which... how did Goku's brother manage to find us so quickly, anyway?

5.original: That weird device he had on his head gives him data on his enemies' locations and strengths.

6.original:
Really?

Uh, hey, Krillin...? Could you grab that for me?

7.original: Uh... sure. I guess he's not gonna spring back to life or anything...

8.original: Whoa! Hmm... Let's see. This connects to here, I think.

9.original:
Man, what a piece of technology! It's a little singed, but I think I can fix it!

I bet if I can take this home and work on it a little bit...

We could use it to find Yamcha and Tien, too!

10.original: We'd best go back to Kame House for the time being.

11.original: Yeah. Not much else for us to do here.

12.original: And once we're done over there, I'm gonna go start searching for those Dragon Balls!

14.original:
Search for the balls all you want. I don't care.

Not even Kami has the power to raise the dead, after all.

But in the meantime, I'm gonna take care of Goku's son.

15.original: You're kidding me! What're you gonna do with him?

16.original:
With the right training, that Gohan kid could acquire a massive amount of power.

We'll need that to fight off the two Saiyans due here in a year's time.

I'll need to build up his strength before then. That's the only way to do it.

18.original: I... I'm not so sure this is a good idea.

19.original: No... we should at least consult with Goku and Chi-Chi about this first.

20.original:
We don't have that kind of time!

I'm taking Gohan with me... and I don't care if I have to kill you all to shut you up!

21.original:
I'll be back at your place with the kid in a year.

If you resurrect Goku before that, tell him he can meet up with us then.

22.original: You have to open your eyes. You are the son of Goku.

24.original: We need to talk. Get out of the water.

26.original: Geh... stupid kid! Stop wasting my time, you whiny brat!

28.original:
Quit crying!! Shut up before I break your neck!

All right, you. Listen to me carefully.

Your father is dead, all right?

You probably remember a little from the fight. He sacrificed himself to win.

30.original:
Whoa! Don't start crying again! I'll break your neck! I mean it!

Did your father ever tell you about how the Dragon Balls work?

I'm sure Goku's friends will gather them all up again so they can wish him back to life.

31.original:
But that isn't the main issue here.

We managed to take care of the guy who kidnapped you by ourselves.

But we'll have two more of them come here in a year. And they'll be even more dangerous.

Even if they do resurrect Goku before then, there's no way we can win with just the two of us!

We need your power, kid! You need to train, learn to fight. We must protect the Earth together!

32.original:
Huh?!

Train...? Me? I... I couldn't! I, I can't fight at all!

33.original:
It isn't a matter of can or can't! You must!

We aren't gonna accomplish anything here, though... Follow me!

35.original: What? Exhausted already? You think that's gonna be good enough to save the Earth?

36.original: I can't be a warrior... I just don't have what it takes.

37.original:
Maybe you don't realize it, but you've got power inside you that nobody else on Earth does!

You need to train so that power can come to the surface, so you can harness it at will!

38.original: N-no way... I... I don't have anything like that...

40.original:
W-what're you doing?! Oww! S-stop! Stop it!

Waaaaaaahhhh!

41.original: (Come on! Show me what's inside of you! That boulder's going to crush you!)

42.original: Wow... I knew you were strong, but...

43.original:
(I have very mixed feelings about this...)

(I am helping to raise the boy who may become my most fearsome enemy someday...)

45.original:
Yes, you did. Beginning to grasp what you're capable of yet?

Whenever your emotions swell to their peak, you're able to unlock your hidden powers.

It may only last for a moment, but my training will help you work on that.

It'll make you the strongest warrior in the world. You understand me?

46.original: But... but I don't wanna be a warrior... I wanted to be a scholar.

47.original:
I'm not saying you can't. It'll have to wait until after you beat the Saiyans next year, though.

Those guys want to eradicate us off the face of the earth. There'd be no future for anyone then.

49.original:
Quit whining, brat! You want me to kill you right now?!

There's no time to waste. We're starting now! Take your outer clothing off!

50.original:
*sniff* I... I wanna wait for my daddy to get resurrected.

Then I can learn how to fight from him.

51.original:
Heh. Well, tough.

He's strong, I'll grant you that, but he's not cut out to be a teacher.

He's too nice. He doesn't know how to be harsh toward anyone.

I can tell that just by seeing how much of a spoiled brat you are.

Hurry up and get ready. We need to move!

52.original: B-but... what kind of training are we doing?

53.original: You won't be doing anything at first. Just surviving.

55.original:
That's right. You're gonna have to survive by yourself right here from now on.

If you're still alive and well after six months... then I'll teach you how to fight.

56.original:
S-six months? Here? All alone...?!

I don't wanna! I'll die all by myself!

57.original:
Heh heh heh... oh, you won't be by yourself.

There are bloodthirsty creatures all around here.

58.original: Oh, no...! C'mon! Don't just leave me here!

59.original:
You're the key to Earth's future, kid. You'd better not forget that.

Believe in the power you have. Learn how to harness it.

62.original:
Oh, one more thing. Don't try to run away on me.

This place is surrounded by vast deserts on all sides. Compared to that, it's like heaven here.

63.original: W-wait! Where am I gonna find food?! How can I take a bath? Where's my bed?!

64.original: You think I've got any of that for you here, you coddled brat?

66.original: Don't resent me... Resent your fate. That's what I do.

67.original: Wait! I'm scared! Don't leave me here!!

69.original: You're acting kind of weird, Kami. Is there something the matter?

70.original:
It's Piccolo... I knew it. He really has changed.

He's still evil, yes, but I think that cunning viciousness of his is starting to fade away.

71.original: I think you're right. The demon king of the past wouldn't try to make Gohan stronger like this.

72.original:
What clinched it for me was seeing what happened to the soul of Goku's brother...

Raditz found his way to the Other World, the way it should be.

When you're killed by a demon, normally you spend eternity in pain as a wandering ghoul...

But that's not what happened to Raditz. The Piccolo of old never would have allowed that.

73.original: And he's likely noticed that he... and therefore, I... have only one year left to live.

75.original:
Perhaps Piccolo will die at the hands of the Saiyans in a year's time...

Or perhaps I will simply die of natural causes at that time. I cannot say.

My death is Piccolo's, and Piccolo's death is mine.

Heh heh heh.

I may be a great man, yes, but that doesn't mean I enjoy knowing when I'm about to die.

I'm sure he's realized it as clearly as I have.

Perhaps he feels he must leave his mark on the world somehow before he goes.

Even if that thing is the son of his nemesis.

76.original: So... so the Dragon Balls have little time left as well.

77.original: Yes. I imagine the next time they see us will be the last.

80.original: Waaaaahhhhh! I can't get down from here!

83.original:
Hey!

Apples! They just fell out of nowhere! Boy, am I lucky!

85.original:
Ughh! They're so sour! I can't eat this!

I wish I had some pork dumplings...

86.original:
Stupid brat. Making me waste all this time on him.

This is the last time I'm lending him a hand.

If you can't survive after this, then you just aren't strong enough to cut it, period.

87.original:
What am I gonna do...? I'm up too high to get down...

But if I stay here, I'm just gonna starve to death...

88.original: *sniff* Why is this happening to me...?

89.original:
...?

Huh? Why's it so bright? It's supposed to be nighttime.

90.original:
Oh! Wow, it's the moon!

Boy, look at how big and round it is! I've never seen a full... moon... before...

94.original:
W-what's going on here?! He's laying waste to everything in his path!

The Earth's gonna be destroyed before the Saiyans even show up!

95.original:
Quit acting so stupid, Kakarot.

When we Saiyans see a full moon, our full latent abilities are unlocked! You know that!

98.original:
Huff... huff... I never even thought he'd transform like that...

It must be his Saiyan blood... It's got to be the secret behind his and Goku's strength.

99.original:
Destroying the moon was definitely the right thing to do...

It scares me to even think about what'd happen if the Saiyans pulled that stunt.

100.original:
I remember how much Raditz kept going on about tails...

I guess you need both a tail and the full moon to transform.

101.original:
I better cut his tail off...

He can't transform anymore, but the tail's still a weak point for Saiyans like him.

102.original:
Right...

Might as well spot him a sword and some clothing... The same design as your dad's and everything.

103.original: Heh heh... The character written on it is mine, though.

104.original:
I need to go... I've got training of my own to do.

If you can survive in this place for six months...

Then I'm gonna put you through the sort of hellish training only Piccolo can give you.

You'll wish you were dead, believe me... I hope you'll be ready.

105.original: I'm going to make you into the greatest demon there ever was!

106.original:
We can't keep this from Chi-Chi...

Krillin, you go and tell her.

108.original: You probably won't makeit back alive.I hear she's the strict type...

111.original:
Right...But be careful how you say it.

Not only do you haveto tell her about Goku,but Gohan too!

113.original:
Hmm...You might not want to tellher about Gohan just yet...

But being someone who's diedand was brought back to lifeonce before...

You should be able to explainabout Goku, right?

118.original:
I could fix that machine thatGoku's brother was using if onlyI had a Precision Circuit.

There should be one at my housein West City......

120.original: Yeah.Do you think you could bring meback a Precision Circuiton your way back?

121.original: A Precision Circuit?...OK.I'll make a stop over inWest City then.

124.original:
No no no, that would put her intotoo much shock.

Umm... I'm so sorry, Chi-Chi,but Goku has fallen into a deepsleep that he'll nevercome back from...

125.original: ...Wait a second, we'll be ableto bring him back to life.

126.original:
Yeah, that's it! I'll keep it positive!

Goku died, but don't worry! We can bring him back!

130.original: Umm, well...You see, there's something I uh...Uhh...

133.original: Weren't you supposed to be withGoku and the others?

134.original: Well, I was but...What happened was, Goku, he...He...

138.original: He... He...He told me to tell you notto worry about them!Heh heh...

139.original: That's it?!So, he's gonna be late then...

140.original: Uh, right...But actually,he might not... come back...

142.original: Well, he'll be back,but just not right away...

143.original: Krillin!!I can't make sense out of a thingyou're saying...

144.original:
How about you come inside,Krillin. No point standingaround like this...

Come on now, come on in.

146.original: What's taking him so long?!He said they'd be backbefore dark!

147.original:
Nothing we can do,so we might as well juststart eatin'!

Goku will have Gohan back beforeya know it...

149.original: That Goku's gone too farthis time!This is a very important time forGohan right now...

151.original:
Well, we couldn't just keepit from her.

Let's just hope she can becalmed down...

153.original:
*Sigh...*

I'm really in for it now...I can't just tell her whatreally happened...

I gotta get back to theKame House...

155.original:
Hmm, Bulma wanted me to getsomething for her.

I think she said it was at CapsuleCorporation in West City...I guess I should go and get it.

156.original: OK!Time to go back to theKame House.

160.original:
It's been a while since they've allbeen to the Kame House...

They probably just lost track oftime talking and catching up...

161.original: How could he...Gohan has cram school to go to!!

162.original: C-come on now!Gohan's four years old!Skipping a day wouldn't hurt...

163.original: You're too soft on him!!Studying's the only thing that'sgonna get him ahead in this world!

164.original:
Hey, you guys!

Get up!I finally got it working!!

167.original:
Hey!I've been working all nighton this thing!

How can you two just sleepwhile I do all the work?

169.original: Get up you lazy old turtle man!

171.original:
I made the characters on thisthing easier to read.

Let's see... 139...!This number representsMaster Roshi's power level!

172.original:
139, huh?

My, my...That's some contraption.

It can tell something like that?

177.original:
This thing that the Saiyan worecan tell you the power level ofanyone in the world...

It can even tell you wherethey're located!

178.original:
...Huh?

Looks like there's a power of 250about 2000 miles from here!I wonder who it could be?

185.original: That means Gohan should bethere with him...!

186.original: D-do you think we should gosave him?!

187.original:
No...

He's got plans for Goku's boy...

Besides,you think you could face him?

188.original:
.........

329 is too much for me...It'd be suicide...

189.original:
...But, with this we know whereYamcha and the others are!

If we all pull together we couldfind the Dragon Balls in no time!

Then we could bring Goku backto life!

193.original:
Hey!

You're that guy that was onKorin Tower!Umm... Alumajiro, right?

194.original: It's Yajirobe, you twit!You did that on purpose,didn't you?!

195.original:
Who builds a house in a placelike this?!Took me forever to find it!

I'm only here because Korinhas a message for you!

197.original:
He knows about what happened.

That's why he wants you,Yamcha, Chiaotzu and what's hisname to come right away!

199.original: Kami says he's gonna train ya.Same for me.

201.original:
Yeah, that's right.Even though I said I didn't wannafight no stinkin' superstrong aliens...

Looks like I got no choice.

202.original: All right!!We'll find everyone and headover there!

203.original: Well, I did my job.I'm outta here.

204.original:
Oh!

And one more thing...Don't bring Goku back to lifeuntil the aliens get here.

206.original:
Goku's gonna be training on theother side.

If you wanna know the details,that old woman called FortunetellerBaba will be around,so ask her about it.

208.original: That Goku...Not even death can stop him...

214.original: Good to see you, Master!How have you been?

217.original:
Goku and my son are supposedto be here!

Where are they?Inside?

222.original: I can't believe him!!What could he possibly havebeen thinking?!

223.original:
Th-there's nothing we can do...

Goku said he wanted a yearto train...

224.original:
Who cares about Goku!I'm worried about my Gohan!

My poor Gohan...Piccolo could be doing somethinghorrible to him this very minute...

225.original: Now, now Chi-Chi...Calm yourself down a bit.

226.original:
How could I be calm at a timelike this?!

What's wrong with you, dad?!

228.original:
Well, first things first...

We need to get all the Dragon Ballstogether so we can be ready tobring Goku back.

230.original:
No problem!

...Although it might take sometime trying to find themby myself...

231.original:
Hey, wait!

I can use the machine that Goku'sbrother used to find where Tienand Yamcha are!

232.original:
Looks like Tien is... to the north.

From the distance,he's probably somewhere aroundJingle Village...

235.original: Oh great...What's that guy think he's upto at a time like this?!

237.original: He's still in his hideout!I wonder if he'll even be upfor training...

239.original:
OK!Now that we know where those twoare, we need to bring them here!

Then we'll search forthe Dragon Balls!

240.original: What are you waiting for?!Hurry up and find thoseDragon Balls so you can bring Gokuback to life and save my Gohan!!

243.original:
Tien! There you are!

...Never thought I'd find youtraining in a place like this!

244.original:
...! Is that you, Krillin?!Good to see ya!

...What're you doing here?

247.original:
Yeah!

Yajirobe from Korin's place showedup at Master Roshi's place.

He said you, me, Yamcha and Chiaotzuall need to come to Korin Tower.

252.original:
Well...Goku's brother showed up and...Then Goku was killed and...

Aliens are going to come to Earthin one year's time...

...So, yeah...

253.original:
Krillin, you're making no sense...

Tell me what's going on,but go slower this time.

254.original: ...I see.So that's what's been going on...

255.original: That's why we have to find Yamchaand get to Kami's place as quickas possible!

256.original: ...I'd go with you,but I can't right away...

259.original:
L-Launch?! You don't mean...She's not still followingyou around, is she?

Why don't you just leave her inthe dust?

262.original: ...The thing is, there's a child in this village with an extremely high fever...

263.original:
There's a secret medicine needed to bring the fever down...

Launch went to search for it beyond here in the Holly Plains...

264.original: She left the village yesterday and hasn't come back...

265.original:
I told her I'd go find the medicine myself, but she wouldn't listen and went off on her own...

I was just going to go and look for her...

266.original:
OK!

If that's how it is, I'll help you search for her!

268.original: Of course! Now that it's settled, let's get going!

269.original:
All right. She should be somewhere in Holly Plains...

We may be able to gather information if we asked around town.

273.original:
Yo, Tien! You're a sight for sore eyes!

You wouldn't believe the trouble I've had! I got lost while looking for that Hyacinth flower!

Not to mention how cold it's been. I can't stop sneezin'!!

275.original:
Yeah!

But I was able to find the key to the gate beyond here!

276.original:
Good! But it looks dangerous from here on out...

You should head back to Jingle Village.

277.original:
Whoa, hold it there!! I haven't come this far for nothin', you know?

Don't be treating me like I'd be in the way or you'll have another thing comin'!!

278.original: N-no one's saying you'd be in the way! ...We just are worried for you, that's all...

279.original:
Worried for me? Then quit fussing and just take me with...

Aa... Aa...

Aachoo!!!

282.original: Oh, nothing... You just went out on your own and we were worried, so...

283.original:
Oh, I did?!

It's cold here... I'm going to go back to the village!

284.original: Y-yes... I think that would be best.

285.original:
Everyone be careful not to catch a cold...

Aa... Aa......

288.original:
Come on now, boys!! Let's get a move on!

Time to get that Hyacinth flower!

290.original:
There it is! We found it!

This should help that kid get better!!

291.original: ...So, why did you try coming to a place like this all on your own?

292.original:
Huh? No special reason!

It's just that that kid was a wreck!!

There was no choice! Someone had to do it, right?

293.original: I understand how you feel, but you could have left it to me...

294.original: I just... Well... I thought maybe I'd be of some help to you is all...

300.original: The dragon in Holly Plains is supposed to be peaceful and not attack people...

301.original: ...Either way, Launch would have been in real trouble just by herself...

302.original: Hmph! I can take care of myself.

303.original:
...H-Hey, well, at least we can get the Hyacinth flower now...

We should hurry back to the village and give it to the child! ...Right? Hah hah...

304.original: You're right... Let's get out of here!

305.original: Isn't the Hyacinth flower medicine ready? Hurry up!

307.original: Here ya go... It's a little bitter, but you can take it...

309.original: *Groans...* Huh? Hey, it doesn't hurt anymore...

310.original: All riiight!! How about that? Better already, huh?

311.original: Thank you so much! I'll never forget your kindness...

316.original: I am not, you little twerp! Now, come on... Our work is done here, so let's go!

317.original: Tien... Now we can go and look for Yamcha!

318.original: Yeah... I'm looking forward to training with Kami. Let's get ready to go...

322.original:
What? You think I'm just gonna end up in the way again?

I gotta get outta this freezing place...

Aa... Aa......

324.original: ...Oh, no... Now where am I? Where am I?

325.original: Tien... We should go while we can...

327.original: Krillin, do you know where Yamcha is?

328.original: Yeah. Bulma says he's back at his hideout!

330.original:
All right!! The bridge is fixed!

Now we can cross Mount Paozu and get to Yamcha's place!

331.original:
Yeah! ...But we best not lower our guard!

There's probably bandits and monsters crawling all over the place up ahead...

336.original:
We've been good!

How about you? You haven't been slacking on training, have you?

337.original:
Course not!!

Not with how Goku showed me up at the last World Martial Arts Tournament!!

I'm not gonna let that happen again!

338.original:
Anyway, what's up guys?

What's with the serious faces? Goku's not with you?

341.original: ...Right. He's training on the other side as we speak.

342.original:
That's why we have to have training personally from Kami himself...

Will you come with us?

343.original: What'd ya think?! Of course I'll go!

344.original: Good! It's settled. Now then, let's get going...

345.original:
We could go straight to Korin's Tower right now...

But it might be a good idea to stop by Master Roshi's place first.

347.original: Good to see you again, Master Roshi.

348.original:
Yamcha!

How could you go into hiding like that?!

I bet you were just messing around the whole time!

349.original: N-no, I wasn't, Bulma! I went back to my old hideout continued my training...

352.original:
Well, anyway...

We're off to train with Kami!

355.original:
...Oh, no... Was just thinking about how far you've all come.

Normally, I'd want to fight alongside, but now I don't think I could keep up!

357.original:
...No, no, don't pretend it's not true.

I'm sure my training won't even compare to Kami's training...

Give it all you've got!

359.original:
Who do you think you are? This is a sacred place!

If you've no business here, then off with you!!

362.original:
No, we're not... strange...

We received a message from Yajirobe and we're here to see Korin...

Umm... I've climbed Korin Tower before...

But no one was here then...

363.original: Oh! We heard you would be coming.

367.original:
Oh, no... Don't worry about it...

Are you by any chance... Bora...?

373.original:
Yeah! Man, it sure has been a long time!

You look like you've grown up! I couldn't even tell who you were!

374.original:
The same goes for you, Krillin.

You've changed quite a bit... Or... have you?

375.original: So... Goku has saved the world again, huh?

376.original: Father! Now it's our turn to save Goku!

378.original: Up ahead is Korin Tower. Now, off with you...

380.original: We couldn't help it. A lot happened...

381.original: All right now, what's the ruckus all about?

382.original:
These guys took so long to get here...

I was starting to think they wouldn't be able to take the training!

383.original: Korin! It's good to see you again!

384.original:
So, you finally made it!

I was watching what went on below, so I guess there was nothing you could do...

385.original: So, I suppose we are off to see Kami then...?

387.original: There's a little favor I have to ask!

389.original: Yeah, that's right. It has to do with Senzu beans...

391.original: Yeah... I grow them down at the bottom of the tower and I forgot to give them water... The seedlings all dried up.

393.original:
That's right. What I need you to do is...

Go down there and get the water needed for raising Senzu!

394.original:
What?!

After we climb all the way up here we have to go back down again?!

395.original: Don't get so worked up, Krillin... This is part of training.

396.original: Korin! We'd be glad to carry out the task!

397.original: I'm counting on you! But just so you know, the water I use for Senzu plants isn't just any normal water...

399.original:
There's a cave in the sacred land...

The water comes up from a spring deep inside the cave called Hermit's Spring. Will you do it?

403.original: So we just need to take the water from here, right? Let's get this water back and get to training!

406.original:
Hey, you there!!

This is Korin's special water! I'm not gonna just let you have it!

407.original:
...Hey, calm down.

Korin himself asked us to come and get the water for him!

408.original: What's that?! Lying won't get you anywhere!!

409.original:
...Whew...

How could Korin not tell us ahead of time about that weird thing being here? Would've been nice to know...

410.original: Well, at least we were able to get the water from the spring...

411.original: All right! Let's hurry back to the tower!

413.original: Korin! We brought back the water from Hermit's Spring!

414.original: Oh ho ho!! That was faster than I expected!

415.original:
...Let's see here...

Ahh! This is some good water you brought me...

418.original: Would you go to the bottom and give my Senzu plants this water for me?

419.original: Huh?! I suppose I've got no say in the matter...

422.original: We met some weird thing at Hermit's Spring...

423.original:
Oh! I forgot to tell you!

That's the spirit of the water. It protects the water for me down there while I'm up in the tower!

425.original: Hah hah. He's got a good senseof humor. He give you all awarm welcome?

427.original: We don't mean to be in a rush,but could you show us toKami's place?

428.original:
Oh! That's right!

...But to get there, you're gonnaneed a power pole!

429.original:
...A power pole?The pole that Goku carried around?

So, we won't be able to get therewithout it?

430.original:
Don't worry!

The last time Goku tried to go toKami's place, he said he lostthe pole.

So I made something justin case...

I didn't think I'd have to use itso soon...

431.original:
Here, take it!

Good luck with your trainingwith Kami!!

437.original:
